plugins.name: chorus
plugins.description: Private-by-default local voice feedback for coding agents on macOS Apple Silicon.
plugins.installation: Install the plugin, review its hooks, then run /chorus:setup in a new thread.
plugins.authentication: No credentials for local mode; optional external summary provider credentials for standard or detailed mode.
plugins.privacy: Local audio by default. Listen mode needs microphone permission. Standard and detailed modes can transmit selected text after explicit setup consent.
